say:1:1820508001:1.text: Look at all those dense bushes and rocks over there. There are blind spots everywhere! Great for an ambush—I mean, a prank.
say:1:1820508001:1.source_cn: 远处那块地段比较合适！周围树丛茂密，巨石的分布容易形成...

say:2:1820508002:1.text: Sounds good! We can pick up everything we need along the way, then find somewhere to make the pumpkin ghost.
say:2:1820508002:1.source_cn: 听你的！我们沿路寻找素材，再找块地方提前做好“南瓜幽灵”。

say:3:1820508003:1.text: There are plenty of spooky things around here we can use!
say:3:1820508003:1.source_cn: 放心吧，这里肯定有许多比南瓜还恐怖的东西，肯定能派上用场！
